operations.title: The generic q_G quartic double solid has eight C2^3-related A1 nodes
operations.body: On det(G)!=0, the exact support-pattern gradient audit leaves only Delta=0. Projectively this is the eight-point sign orbit [1:epsilon2:epsilon3:epsilon4], and every point has the threefold A1 local type. The positive source chain reaches only [1:1:1:1].
